data.name: G.H.O.S.T. Ghost Hunt Ops Special Team
data.detailed_description:
G.H.O.S.T. (Ghost Hunt Ops Special Team) is a tactical co-op horror for 1–4 players. The invasion from the astral plane has already begun. You are elite operatives of a specialized Agency, the only ones capable of tracking, suppressing, and capturing entities that have breached our world.

Your Mission: Halt the Breach

A Ghost is prowling the operation zone, searching for seven ancient Runes. If it gathers them all, a massive portal will open, unleashing a legion of spirits into our reality. You must stop the ritual at any cost.

G.H.O.S.T. Operative Duty:

  • Identify via Anomalies: The Ghost periodically emits powerful Waves of Disturbance. These pulses generate physical anomalies. Use your handheld Meter to study their properties—it’s the only way to accurately identify the Ghost type and select the correct charge for your weapons.

  • Capture the Target: Once the entity is identified, deploy the Devastators. Coordinate your fire: the Ghost must be held under a barrage of lightning for about 10 seconds. When the entity weakens and shrinks—grab it and return to base.

  • Risk and Reward: Use your Radiation Detector to find objects charged with torsional radiation and the Runes themselves. The Agency pays handsomely in credits for these. But beware: the moment you take a Rune, the Ghost will drop everything to hunt you down ruthlessly.

  • Safe Zones: The only place to catch your breath and hide from attacks is within the radius of the Barrier Towers. Outside this zone, you are defenseless against the Ghost's Torsional Radiation, which can knock you unconscious in seconds.

Agency Headquarters (The Base)

Between missions, you return to the Base—your central command. Here you can:

  • Purchase advanced gadgets and more powerful weaponry.

  • Repair gear worn down in battle to ensure it doesn't fail at a crucial moment.

  • Receive special secret assignments with good payouts from the Agency.

Join the ranks of G.H.O.S.T. Stand as the barrier between our world and the astral nightmare!

data.short_description: G.H.O.S.T. — a tactical co-op for 1-4 players. Your main objective: track the Ghost via anomalies and capture it before it collects 7 runes to open the portal. Use Devastators, secure torsional artifacts, and remember—you are there to stop the invasion, not to become its victim.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5300
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
